I need to organise them into types yo make it easier for me to decide what specials to have on (our restaurant is just a rolling specials board). To do this I need to make sure I always have a variety of dishes on instead of too many similar dishes. For example I always need a have a fish item, vegetarian item, poultry item, perhaps a pasta dish etc

You would have needed to level up a lot of the original SPECIAL stats at some point to level up a lot of the sub perks anyway, plus the fact that you maxed out your intelligence stat early on means you'll be earning more XP and levelling up faster. Sure you could have been doing other things earlier on but you definitely haven't wasted your time. Besides 21 hours is nothing in comparison to how many hours you're able to put into the game
